# Jeremiah 43 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 43:1 (overlap: 7%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-it-was when-Jeremiah finished speaking to all the-people all [the]-words-of YHWH their-God, with-which YHWH their-God had-sent-him to-them — all these words — |
| LOGOS | When Jeremiah finished speaking to all the people all these words of the LORD their God, with which the LORD their God had sent him to them, |
| PNEUMA | When Jeremiah had finished giving the people the LORD's complete message — |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
